title: Orbital Remnants: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common Orbital Remnants failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If orbital routes fail, do not add more objectives. Add more oxygen, repair capability, navigation clarity, and a shorter extraction plan.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If offworld routes collapse, reduce objectives and increase oxygen, repair margin, route marking, and extraction discipline before trying again.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
